_comment: Drives index.md grouping and the closed `domain` vocabulary. Edit here, then run `ugraph index`. Anything unmatched lands under 'Other' — never silently dropped.
_entity_dirs_comment: subtype -> directory name. Explicit because naive pluralization gives 'persons'.
_page_types_comment: Page types beyond the format's built-ins (concept, entity, source, raw-transcript, moc, overview, note). Values list EXTRA required frontmatter fields; `type` and `title` are always required. Built-in types cannot be weakened here — the toolchain depends on them.
